BabiMind Web Research & Decision Agent — final report. Before the report: I have no live web/tools in this session, so I am bound to the repository evidence you supplied. That evidence is itself degraded, and that fact drives the entire conclusion. This is decision-support output from the BabiMind pipeline, not personal financial advice, and it guarantees nothing.

⚠️ DATA-INTEGRITY ALERT (read first — this governs everything below)
- Every Tier-1 primary source is DOWN this run: TSETMC (MarketWatch, Client Type, Index, Funds, Codal, Shareholders, Price History), Codal, TSE gateway, and IFB all timed out (babimind_source_health.json). I therefore cannot cross-check a single number against official truth. Per your own rule (primary > secondary, missing ≠ zero), no high-confidence decision is possible.
- The only live market evidence is Kamandar (secondary), and it reports the market CLOSED with last trading day 20 Aban 1405 (≈ 2026-11-11). Pipeline generated_at is 2026-11-12.
- The formal فملی thesis is STALE and its price map is INVALID. symbol_theses (updated_at 2026-09-04) is built on price_1405_06_04 = 19,950 rial with accumulation 19,400–19,800, targets 20,500–23,000, risk 18,800. Kamandar shows فملی at 28,280 on 20 Aban 1405 — roughly +42% above the thesis. Every level in that thesis is now 30–45% below market and must be discarded/rebuilt.
- Global/commodity layer is empty: babimind_global_market_snapshot.json is "pending_upstream_data" for copper, oil, gold, DXY, rates — I have NO pipeline copper price to support the copper-lever thesis.
- Forecasting and Decision stages are "not_connected" (babimind_model_stage_status.json). Factor coverage is 100% but 250/500 are only "Partial," and inflation/liquidity/macro each depend on a single healthy source (CBI).

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY (≤10)
1. Cannot issue a verified trade decision: all primary Iranian market/fundamental sources are offline this run. 🟢 (source_health)
2. Only usable tape is Kamandar (secondary), last session 20 Aban 1405: TEDPIX 8,427,304 +0.83%, equal-weight 2,356,433 +0.78%, breadth 602+/392−, buy/sell queues 321/198. 🟡 (single secondary source, unverified)
3. Real-money net buy reported +5,985 B rial and retail value 364.2 T rial — a constructive tape IF accurate; not cross-checkable (TSETMC Client Type down). 🟡
4. Leadership has ROTATED AWAY from copper/base-metals: فلزات اساسي −1.06% and فملی −2.98% on the day, while refining (شپنا +2.94%, شتران +2.87%), steel (فولاد +2.91%), petrochem and small/mid caps led. 🟡
5. The فملی bull thesis is stale on two axes: price levels invalid, and the leader is now underperforming the index it was supposed to lead. 🔴 for the thesis as written.
6. Recent memory scenarios (0.40/0.40/0.20) have been copied forward unchanged for ~2 weeks across runs — a calibration red flag; they are not updating with evidence. 🔴
7. Macro/geopolitics is the dominant live risk: news (2026-11-12) centers on a US "Iron Gate" blockade of Iran, Hormuz tanker incidents, and Brent whipsawing ~$90–94. Escalation risk is high and two-sided. 🟡 (news, not primary)
8. Options are NOT actionable: your own ranked files are labeled "data_completeness_only_not_a_trade_signal"; several top "risk-adjusted" rows are junk (negative time value, crossed/zero quotes, ~0 OI, near-expiry) and must be excluded. 🔴
9. Market P/E 7.45 and RSI(TEDPIX) 56.47 (Kamandar) — mid-range, not stretched, not oversold. 🟡
10. Correct action per your own rules ("prefer WAIT/NO TRADE when evidence or R/R is inadequate"): WAIT / NO TRADE, low confidence, and re-run when primary sources restore.

MARKET REGIME
- Broad market (secondary only): constructive / risk-on — 🟡 low confidence.
- Leadership: TRANSITION — rotation out of copper/base-metals into refining, steel, and equal-weight small/mid caps.
- Not classifiable as a confirmed Bull regime because breadth/flow cannot be verified against TSETMC and global drivers are missing.

EVIDENCE (source · timestamp · confidence)
- TEDPIX 8,427,304 +0.83% (+69,462); equal-weight 2,356,433 +0.78%; IFX 70,834 +0.53% — Kamandar indices, collected 2026-11-12T17:33Z, last session 20 Aban 1405. 🟡
- Breadth 602 pos / 392 neg; queues 321 buy / 198 sell; real-money +5,985 B rial; retail value 364.2 T rial; P/E 7.45; RSI 56.47 — Kamandar market-report/1405-08-20. 🟡 (conflict note: the indices-page intraday pulse showed 371/245; the daily report shows the 602/392 close — market broadened into the close; I trust the EOD report for the session, but cannot verify either.)
- TSETMC/Codal/TSE/IFB: all timed out — babimind_source_health, checked 2026-11-12T17:45Z. 🔴 (this is why confidence is capped)
- Global snapshot: all transmission channels "pending_upstream_data" — artifacts/babimind_global_market_snapshot.json. 🔴

MACRO
- Oil/geopolitics: Brent ~$90–94, volatile; US blockade of Iran ("Iron Gate," ~$30B oil-revenue loss cited), Hormuz tanker incidents, Iran floating 7 conditions; diesel crack spread ~3x in Europe — news digest 2026-11-12. 🟡 (news, not primary; direction two-sided: higher oil helps Iranian refiners/exporters nominally, but blockade + escalation is a severe macro tail-risk).
- Iran FX / rates / inflation / liquidity / monetary base: NOT AVAILABLE as data this run. CBI site is up but no series ingested; Statistical Center of Iran is down (SSL). Only qualitative news (CBI/همتی commentary on monetary-base growth). 🔴 — do not infer numbers.

INDUSTRY ROTATION (1-day only — Kamandar, 20 Aban 1405)
- Leaders: استخراج نفت +11.0% (thin/illiquid index, treat cautiously), انتشار و چاپ +2.99%, فني مهندسي +2.98%, هتل و رستوران +2.96%, تامين آب/برق/گاز +2.93%, لاستيك +2.60%, ساير معادن +2.45%, فراورده نفتي +2.40%, شيميايي +2.32%.
- Laggards: ذغال سنگ −2.47%, محصولات چوبي −2.33%, محصولات چرمي −1.69%, بيمه −1.47%, حمل و نقل −1.27%, خرده‌فروشي −1.12%, فلزات اساسي −1.06%.
- 5-day and 20-day flow/RS: NOT AVAILABLE in evidence — I will not fabricate them. 🟡 (1-day only)

SYMBOLS
- Best available candidates (unverified, secondary tape only): شپنا 12,590 +2.94%, شتران 6,450 +2.87%, فولاد 4,950 +2.91%, وتجارت 966 +2.99%, شستا 3,690 +2.79% — refiners/steel/banks with an oil tailwind. Cannot confirm flow, per-capita, or legal/real split (TSETMC down). 🟡
- Highest-risk / avoid-chasing: فملی 28,280 −2.98% (highest value traded but negative; thesis stale; base-metals sector −1.06%; copper price unknown). Also weak: وبصادر −2.89%, ذوب −2.34%, and the worst small-caps (ذغال/چوب/چرم). 🔴 for فملی-as-thesis.

FUNDS / LEGAL PERSONS / SMART-MONEY
- Not determinable. TSETMC Client Type and Shareholders are offline; Kamandar gives an aggregate real-money +5,985 B rial but no per-symbol real/legal split, no 1/5/10/20-session legal-person persistence, no fund NAV/discount data. Any "smart money" label on فملی or the market would be inference, not evidence. Confidence 🔴.

OPTIONS
- Not actionable. BRS snapshot (288 contracts, event 2026-11-12T17:45Z) is explicitly "data_completeness_only_not_a_trade_signal." The risk-adjusted top rows are dominated by artifacts (negative time value, bid≥ask or zero-ask, ~0 OI, sub-week expiry) — excluded per your expired/illiquid rule. FMLI option IVs where present are high (~0.63–0.93) with negative theta on several strikes; nothing here justifies a directional options trade without a synchronized Greek/quote source. 🔴

SCENARIOS (probabilities sum to 1.0; confidence LOW — evidence insufficient)
- 🟢 Bull (0.30): Broad risk-on persists (breadth/queues/real-money inflow hold), oil stays firm, and leadership rotates back into metals with a fresh, verified breakout. Confirmation: TEDPIX holds >8.4M with volume; equal-weight ≥ cap-weight; FMLI reclaims leadership on expanding volume with real-money inflow ≥3 sessions; copper price confirmed firm. Invalidation: real-money flow reverses; breadth <400.
- 🟡 Base (0.45): Range/rotation continues; index choppy 8.2–8.5M area, leadership fragmented (refiners/steel vs. metals), no clean edge. Confirmation: breadth mixed 450–600, moderate value, no primary-source confirmation. Invalidation: decisive break either way on volume.
- 🔴 Bear (0.25): Geopolitical escalation (Hormuz blockade tightens / tanker strikes) OR unverifiable-data disappointment triggers risk-off; equal-weight leads down, metals and banks underperform. Confirmation: breadth <350, real-money outflow, IFX/equal-weight lead down. Invalidation: de-escalation + data restoration + flow recovery.
(These are deliberately flatter/lower-conviction than the frozen memory scenarios, which I judge mis-calibrated.)

DECISION
- Regime: Broad = constructive (🟡 low conf); Leadership = Transition (metals → refining/steel/small-cap).
- Primary strategy: 🟡 WAIT / ⚪ NO TRADE — no new positions until (a) primary sources restore and (b) the فملی thesis is rebuilt at current price.
- Score: 40/100 (tape ~ok, but verification, stale thesis, empty global layer, and geopolitical risk dominate). Not actionable.
- Risk: High (data + geopolitical).
- Confidence: 25/100.
- Best industry (1-day, unverified): refining/petrochemicals (فراورده نفتي, شپنا/شتران) with steel secondary.
- Best symbol (candidate, unverified): شپنا — liquid, oil-aligned, positive on the day; needs flow/valuation confirmation.
- Highest-risk symbol: فملی — stale thesis, negative divergence vs. index, copper unknown.
- Key support / resistance: cannot state responsibly — the thesis levels are invalid and I have no verified chart. Rebuild from a fresh TSETMC/technical pull. (Do not use 18,800 / 20,000 / 23,000 — those belong to a 19,950 price that no longer exists.)
- Main catalyst: US–Iran / Hormuz (oil price) and restoration of TSETMC/Codal data.
- Main risk: acting on stale, unverifiable data while geopolitical tail-risk is elevated.
- Entry trigger: primary sources online + FMLI (or chosen leader) stabilizes with confirmed real-money inflow and a firm copper/oil read.
- Exit trigger: n/a (no position).
- Invalidation of this WAIT: a fully verified, cross-checked setup with defined R/R — which does not exist in this run.

IF I WERE THE INVESTOR
1. Buy now or wait? WAIT. The tape looks constructive, but I cannot verify a single number against TSETMC/Codal, the global layer is empty, and the flagship thesis is stale. No edge, no trade.
2. If already holding? I can't tell you reduce/sell without your cost basis and a verified current price. If you hold فملی from the ~19–20k thesis era, you are sitting on a large unrealized gain while near-term leadership has rotated away — a rebuilt trailing-stop discipline (level defined off a fresh chart, not the dead 18,800 line) is the prudent frame. This is risk management logic, not a sell call.
3. Priority industry: refining/petrochemicals and steel (leaders on the last session with an oil tailwind) — pending verification.
4. Avoid for now: the copper/base-metals complex as a leadership bet (فملی underperforming, فلزات اساسي −1.06%), plus coal/wood/leather (worst 1-day performers).
5. Best opportunity: cannot certify one; leading candidate is liquid refiners (شپنا) given oil — but unconfirmed on flow/valuation.
6. Most dangerous setup: chasing فملی (or high-IV فملی calls) on the stale thesis while it lags the market and copper is unverifiable.
7. Single event that would reverse the view: restoration of primary data showing FMLI reclaiming leadership on confirmed real-money inflow with a firm copper price (bullish reversal), OR a Hormuz/escalation shock (bearish reversal).

WHAT MUST HAPPEN BEFORE A REAL DECISION
- Re-run the pipeline when TSETMC + Codal + TSE/IFB respond; require Client Type, Market Watch, and Index endpoints OK.
- Rebuild the فملی thesis at the current price regime (drop 19,950-era levels); regenerate support/resistance/targets from a fresh, timestamped price series.
- Populate the global layer (copper, Brent, gold, DXY) so the commodity→sector mapping is evidence-based, not "pending."
- Recalibrate memory: the frozen, copy-forward scenarios should be flagged and re-derived from current evidence, not carried.
- Only then re-score and, if warranted, move to SCALE-IN BUY / REDUCE with defined entry, staged tranches, and market-structure-based invalidation.

Bottom line: the responsible BabiMind output on this evidence is WAIT / NO TRADE with low confidence — the data needed to decide is offline, and the one symbol with a formal thesis is priced ~42% above that thesis. Preserve capital, fix the data pipeline, rebuild the thesis, then look for edge.
